    SteamOS 0.5.10 Beta for Steam Frame
    SteamOS 0.5.10 (for Steam Frame) has just been released. This update is for the Steam Frame Beta channel, and includes new features that are still being tested. You can opt into this in Settings > System > System Update Channel. New in 0.5.10 Image Quality Improvements Improved streaming decode performance, allowing for higher default streaming resolutions. Added global display sharpness control (defaulting to ON). Users can tune to personal preference, in VR Settings > Display > Display Sharpness. Reduced "green tint" on high frequency greyscale image content. Reduced head wobble when streaming remote desktops. General Fixed hang on Steam Frame logo at boot after updating the OS. Improved Multi-Link Streaming robustness under adverse network conditions. Improved eye-tracking l…  ( 1 min )
    Steam Machine: Reservation and waitlist updates
    We want to share an update on Steam Machine reservations. We've been able to fulfill all current reservations for the 512GB model with no waitlist remaining, and have wrapped up sending purchase invites out to all remaining 2TB reservation holders. However, we are continuing to encounter supply constraints for hardware components, which impacts our ability to source parts.  For Steam Machine, that is especially impacting the 2TB model, where the number of customers on the waitlist exceeds our current production; even when we are able to build more it will be at smaller quantities than we planned. Here's what this means for each model: Steam Machine 512GB: Steam Machine 512GB is now in an add-to-cart status, and you can purchase one directly while supplies last. If and when we get through current inventory, we will flip it to out-of-stock rather than begin building another waitlist. Steam Machine 2TB: We've finished getting purchase invites out to all reservation holders. Those currently on the waitlist will retain their position in line. As always, no one on the waitlist is guaranteed a unit. Because there are more people on the waitlist than units available, we are closing the waitlist to additional signups. The language on the product page will change from "add to waitlist" to "out of stock." If you are on this waitlist, you are welcome to choose to purchase a 512GB model instead (while supplies last). Please note that doing so requires leaving your spot on the waitlist. We expect to have more details to share in January about additional supply.  What's next: We are continuing to build more Steam Machine units, but memory and storage costs continue to increase at unprecedented levels; as a result we don't yet know the number we are able to make, and at what price we'll be able to offer them. The 2TB model in particular will be especially constrained. We anticipate having more information to share come January.  ( 1 min )

Achievement Sets Add sorting to the achievements page to enable sorting by achievement rarity in addition to unlock date. Fixed achievement totals when losing access to a game (for example, after a free weekend). Pinned achievements: global rate is now shown, can now reorder list with a controller.     SteamOS 3.10.0 Preview
    Note: This update is for the Steam Deck Preview channel, and includes new features that are still being tested. You can opt into this in Settings > System > System Update Channel. Note on Preview Releases This is an early Preview build of SteamOS 3.10, and may contain unexpected bugs or stability issues. If you encounter problems, please consider filing a bug on the SteamOS issue tracker. The following notes are an overview, and may not include all changes since the previous SteamOS 3.9 Stable Release. General Updated Arch Linux base Updated Desktop Mode from Plasma 6.7.3 to Plasma 6.8.2 For more information, see https://kde.org/announcements/plasma/6/6.8.0/ Many security and stability improvements Fixed an issue where the "Slow Charger" alert could erroneously appear Fixed Bluetooth audio disconnection when switching between desktop and game modes Update timezone data for Cuba, and Canada's Northwest Territories and Manitoba Game Mode Added support for VK_EXT_present_timing Added support for ASUS ROG Xbox Ally X20 HDR and brightness adjustment Improved frame timing when using the framerate limiter with VRR Improved screen flickering when VRR is enabled while navigating the Steam UI or leaving it idle Improved cursor movement under VRR. It should now match the game's framerate over 30FPS, and stop spiking the panel's refresh rate up to the maximum refresh rate Fixed scaling causing overexposure in certain HDR titles, such as Control Fixed an issue with certain games, such as UBOAT and The Fruit of Grisaia, where the image would flicker and present stale frames in Game Mode AMD Graphics Added support for HDMI 2.1 VRR, FRL, and ALLM Known issue: display may remain blank with the Dell G3223Q NVIDIA Graphics General stability and performance improvements Added support for Mesh Shaders on Turing and newer Fixes rendering corruption in Shadow of the Tomb Raider and The Surge 2 Developer Linux kernel rebased on Linux 7.3  ( 1 min )
    SteamOS 0.5.9 Beta for Steam Frame
    SteamOS 0.5.9 (for Steam Frame) has just been released. This update is for the Steam Frame Beta channel, and includes new features that are still being tested. You can opt into this in Settings > System > System Update Channel. Camera Pass Through / Room View: PC Streaming now supports chroma key to allow Room View to be shown on VR content. Settings are located on the PC side in the Camera section, including a mode switch between Protect Content and Key Content. Key Content will allow any game to simply draw the key color to control Room View transparency.   Note: this feature requires also opting into the beta branch of SteamVR on PC To opt into the beta branch of SteamVR on PC, right-click on SteamVR in your Steam library, select Properties, Game Versions & Beta, and choose beta. General Foveated sharpening is now applied when streaming VR through Steam Link. Added accessibility settings for prism correction (diplopia). Toggle Advanced Settings, then General > Accessibility > Prism Correction. Needs to restart the headset to take effect. Fixed a visual glitch when opening/closing the dashboard in some games. Fixed WebXR support in Chrome/Chromium when installed as user (instead of system-wide) from Discover. Fixed a system lock-up caused by certain apps installed from Discover (eg: VLC). Linked the Show Perf Overlay in VR and Draw Performance Assessment toggles together. Turning off Show Perf Overlay in VR also disables the developer overlay. SteamVR has been updated to version 2.19.3.  ( 1 min )

    Steam Achievement Sets — Now Available to Everyone
    Today, the recent achievements update featuring Steam Achievement Sets and a new achievements page, is available to all Steam users. Achievement Sets are ideal for organizing achievements within a game, making it easier for players to track their progress and discover new achievements as games add them. They also allow games to add new achievements, or new DLC with achievements, without breaking prior game completion. You can read the full blog post here, but here's a quick summary... Track progress by achievement set - You can track progress across each achievement set in a game, each with their own progress bar and trophy. Keep game completion intact - If new achievements are added to a game, it won't break previously completed sets or take away your game completion. DLC achievements - Achievements can now be tied to DLC and can be organized into their own sets, with progress reflected separately from the base game. Complete games or sets with retired achievements - Developers can archive or retire achievements and sets when they're no longer available, preserving them for players who earned them without affecting future completion for everyone else. We've also revamped the achievements page to bring together overall game progress, individual set progress, achievement details, Global Stats, and expanded search and filtering. Enjoy competing with friends? Players can now compare their achievements progress with up to three friends, based on a more accurate total achievement count. Throughout the beta, we've continued to make improvements based on feedback from both players and developers, and we'll continue to do so. We'd like to thank everyone who participated and took the time to share their thoughts. Are you a game developer interested in seeing how easy it is to add achievement sets? Read the Steamworks blog post here.  ( 1 min )

    Steam Client Beta - November 6th
    The Steam Client Beta has been updated with the following changes: General Fixed a case where Steam Cloud Sync would incorrectly show a conflict in some games, e.g. Monster Hunter World Steam Controller Fixed a case where a firmware update would still show up as available for a few seconds after it was applied.     SteamOS 0.5.8 Beta for Steam Frame
    SteamOS 0.5.8 (for Steam Frame) has just been released. This update is for the Steam Frame Beta channel, and includes new features that are still being tested. You can opt into this in Settings > System > System Update Channel. Camera Pass Through / Room View: PC Streaming now supports Room View. Previously, enabling Room View would hide remote content. You can now see remote desktop / remote game theater while camera passthrough is active. PC VR games with OpenXR mixed reality support are now able to blend VR content and camera passthrough. (Example: X-Plane 12) Note: this feature requires also opting into the beta branch of SteamVR on PC To opt into the beta branch of SteamVR on PC, right-click on SteamVR in your Steam library, select Properties, Game Versions & Beta, and choose beta. General Overlay render quality is now always set to Low on Steam Frame, and the option is hidden. This fixes problems that happened when Ultra was selected. Improved eye tracking self-calibration. Fixed low-end gamma response, including inconsistencies between eyes, on some headsets. Fixed a permission issue that prevented WebXR from working in Chrome v157. Developers: Allows OpenXR games streamed from PC to use [c]XR_ENVIRONMENT_BLEND_MODE_ALPHA_BLEND[/c]. SteamVR has been updated to version 2.19.2.  ( 1 min )

    SteamOS 0.5.7 Beta for Steam Frame
    SteamOS 0.5.7 (for Steam Frame) has just been released. This update is for the Steam Frame Beta channel, and includes new features that are still being tested. You can opt into this in Settings > System > System Update Channel. SteamVR: SteamVR has been updated to version 2.19.1 Improved vibration filtering for pose prediction that was affecting some units The display dims for 30 seconds before sleep Foveated sharpening is now independent from Eye Tracking (previously would disable when off, now defaults to centered) Removed Advanced Supersampling support on Steam Frame The guided tour keeps Steam docked front and center Frame Controllers: Battery now shows correctly at 0% Added default bindings for Chromalab, Batman Arkham, and Doom VFR OS: Enable support for WebXR in Chromium 157 & up Audio: Fixed an issue where audio would stop working with USB or Bluetooth speakers if an application tried to access the microphone Added controls to selectively disable echo cancellation and noise suppression for the microphone (requires current Steam Client Beta) You can opt into the Steam Client Beta on headset via Settings > System > Steam Client Update Channel.  ( 1 min )
